page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top centre; page numbers printed at the right ends of entries; catchword "Per" at the lower right.

main_text.head: Discordia.
main_text.l: Assiduum inter pares discordiæ malum, bel- la mouet. | 159.
main_text.head: Dolor.
main_text.l: Crescit dissimulatione ipsa dolor, hoc altius demissus, quominus profiteri licet. | 89.
main_text.head: Fortuna.
main_text.l: Quo se fortuna, etiam fauor hominum inclinat. | 58.
main_text.head: Frugalitas.
main_text.p: Pythagoras genitrice virtutum frugalitatem omnibus ingerebat, consecutusque disputationum assiduitate erat ut matronæ auratas vestes, cæteraque dignitatis suæ ornamenta, velut instrumenta luxuriæ, deponerent. | 182.
main_text.head: Imbecillitas humana.
main_text.l: Nullæ sunt hominum aduersus Deos vires. | 33.
main_text.head: Impius.
main_text.p: Vix parcit suis, qui cum contemptu religionis grassatus est aduersus Deos. | 12.
main_text.head: Ingenium humanum
main_text.p: Quo plura habet ingenium humanum, eo ampliora cupit. | 70.
main_text.head: Libertas.
Luxuria.
Parricidium.
main_text.p: In parricidio, nulla satis iusta causa ad scelle- ris patrocinium prætexi potest. | 157.
main_text.head: Paupertas.
main_text.p: Multum virtutis paupertas aduersus insolentes diuitias habet. | 183.

page.notes: The page number-like marks after entries are page references as printed. Catchword "Per" printed at the foot right. Some entries show ink damage; "Paupertas" and "Ingenium humanum" heads are as printed. Possible misprints in "Paupertas" and "Multum" retained.
